name: Black Dranzer
description: Black Dranzer: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Dark Absorption
ability.description: Every successful damaging move heals Black Dranzer for 20% of actual HP damage inflicted. Steals 4% of the opponent's current ATK and DEF. Stolen stats increase Black Dranzer's ATK and DEF and reduce the opponent's stats by the same amount. Stat stealing lasts 3 rounds. Maximum active stolen stat reduction: 16% per stat. Stat stealing cannot trigger from reflected damage or damage-over-time effects.

special_move.name: Abyssal Phoenix Devourer
special_move.description: Base damage: 190 + 80% ATK. Consumes all stored Dark Energy. Adds bonus damage equal to 100% of consumed Dark Energy. Ignores 20% enemy DEF. Restores HP equal to 30% of actual damage inflicted by the Special. Cooldown: 5 rounds.

abilities.name: Dark Absorption
abilities.description: Every successful damaging move heals Black Dranzer for 20% of actual HP damage inflicted. Steals 4% of the opponent's current ATK and DEF. Stolen stats increase Black Dranzer's ATK and DEF and reduce the opponent's stats by the same amount. Stat stealing lasts 3 rounds. Maximum active stolen stat reduction: 16% per stat. Stat stealing cannot trigger from reflected damage or damage-over-time effects.

abilities.name: Forbidden Phoenix
abilities.description: Whenever Black Dranzer receives damage, absorb 15% of final incoming damage into Dark Energy instead of losing that HP. Maximum Dark Energy storage: 35% of Black Dranzer's maximum HP. Dark Energy remains stored until consumed by the Special. Absorption cannot trigger recursively.
